messages:
Sam CS: Pioneer Labs just pinged procurement. They saw occasional tail latency and asked for immediate credits. They quoted p99 spikes. Need guidance before I reply.
Riley SRE: FYI our SLA for latency uses p95, not p99. Credits are tied to uptime bands. p99 is useful for investigations but not SLA-bound.
Sam CS: Got it. Pioneer is pushing hard on p99. They want ledger export + raw traces. Can we provide both?
Riley SRE: We can. Ledger CSV + evidence bundle (traces + canary histograms). Export path: https://redwood.app/exports/pioneer/ledger-2026-04.csv. Traces link: https://redwood.app/traces/pioneer/2026-04-09
Priya Legal: Quick note: customer comms should avoid "we caused" or admissions. Suggest: 'we observed elevated tail latency; we're providing evidence and a pro-rated credit per SLA after validation.' That keeps it neutral.
Evan Sales: Also ask Pioneer if they're in the 30-day onboarding window. We usually have a short onboarding grace for infra warm-up. If they're still onboarding we can offer dashboard access + joint runbook rather than immediate credit.
Sam CS: They're at day 18. Hmm. Is there a documented onboarding grace policy? I couldn't find a canonical one.
Riley SRE: Not formalized. We have ad-hoc practice. Proposal: formalize a 30-day onboarding grace where credits are withheld for incidents attributable to onboarding changes (rollouts, schema migrations, canary warm-ups) but we still provide full evidence and remediation plan.
Priya Legal: Sounds fine if we document criteria and get customer ack. Need opt-in language.
Evan Sales: I'll offer Pioneer read-only dashboard access and a weekly health cadence. Offer sounds better than blanket credit fight.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Autoscaler triggered 2026-04-09T08:03:21Z for service pioneer-frontend due to burst; baseline nodes increased +2.
Riley SRE: Sample ledger query (approx):
```
-- monthly uptime and request counts
SELECT date, SUM(downtime_seconds) AS down_s, SUM(period_seconds) AS total_s, SUM(requests) AS reqs
FROM sla_checks
WHERE customer = 'pioneer' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY date;
```
Sam CS: Perfect. I'll ask Pioneer if they want the grace policy applied. If they decline we'll follow the SLA credit calc.
Priya Legal: Draft customer paragraph for Sam: 

"Hi Pioneer team 
We observed elevated tail latency intermittently on 2026-04-09. We're sharing the evidence bundle and a ledger export. Per the SLA, any pro-rated credit will be applied after validation. If you'd like, we can enable a read-only dashboard and weekly checkpoint calls to jointly verify traffic patterns while we complete remediation."

Sam CS: Copying that. I'll send now and offer dashboard access + invite for a 30-min runbook call.
Evan Sales: I'll prepare the dashboard invite and include onboarding checklist.
Riley SRE: Action items: (1) Export ledger + evidence bundle (Riley) due EOD today. (2) Draft formal 30-day onboarding grace policy doc (Riley + Priya) due 2026-04-16. (3) Grant read-only dashboard and schedule weekly checks (Evan) due tomorrow.
Sam CS: Thanks team. Sent message to Pioneer, attached export link, offered dashboard and runbook slot. Marking this thread resolved; will reopen if Pioneer pushes for immediate credit.
